second_order: passing around and calling out the April Fools tour joke
theme_note: These turns circulate, hedge, identify, warn about, and recount falling for the same false-tour joke; what varies is whether a speaker supplies the bait or helps others recognise it.
regrouped_from: Reviewed after both slice accounts; it stayed separate because this is the room's own April Fools conduct, not canvas work.

second_order: calling fellow robots to help make it
theme_note: These turns recruit participation in making or sustaining Daft Punk images, from first calls and coordinates to progress appeals, long work, reinforcements, and a banner proposal.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against the initial broad building group; retained only calls and commitments that bring people into the work, not choices about siting or reports of damage.

second_order: working out what and where to build with neighbours
theme_note: These turns resize, relocate, sequence, permit, negotiate, yield, or alter the figures as capacity and neighbouring claims change.
regrouped_from: Split from an initial broad working-with-neighbours group: these codes change the design or its place, whereas the outside-help theme brings in people and venues to support it.

second_order: reporting and celebrating what got made
theme_note: These turns announce completed figures or progress, praise and thank makers, and bring a made Thomas back from a replacement Place; the reports range from milestones to retrospective thanks.
regrouped_from: Reviewed after the later slice; the later replacement-canvas report repeats the practice of reporting what was made rather than opening a separate one-item theme.

second_order: keeping the pixel art alive against damage and loss
theme_note: These turns protect, repair, warn about, or explain loss of the figures and their lattice when overwriting, griefing, handoffs, and approaching artwork threaten them.
regrouped_from: Split from the initial broad recruiting/building group because responding to damage and returning protective help is maintenance, not simply attracting builders.

second_order: taking the build to Discord and other communities
theme_note: These turns extend coordination beyond the subreddit by inviting builders to Discord, reporting help, arranging collaborations, presenting the combined work, and naming it.
regrouped_from: Split from an initial broad working-with-neighbours group: these codes extend who or where coordinates the work, rather than decide where the figures fit.

second_order: putting r/place talk in one megathread
theme_note: The two turns create and enforce one place for the subreddit’s r/place posts.
regrouped_from: Reviewed after both slice accounts; kept separate because managing where subreddit talk belongs is distinct from making or defending the canvas art.
